Figure 5 Example study room on (Fiveable, 2024) 
The novel aspect to the site is the study rooms, enabling students to virtually 
meet with friends and view each other’s progress. This maybe particularly good 
in classrooms enabling the teacher to answer questions in the chat, and monitor 
the students’ progress, when they tick off tasks. The limited literature on this 
would suggest that this would be beneficial to student engagement and learning 
outcomes. 
What seems to let Fiveable down is the educational content, with many 
complains on (Trustpilot, 2024) highlighting “limited and brief” material resulting 
in a low 3.2 stars.
